"""追加Round12原始证据；排除构建目录、私人设置和可执行文件。"""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
out=root/'docs/reports/translation-round12-evidence'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
index={'format':'cloudleaf-round12-evidence-v1','at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
       'implementation_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root).decode().strip(),
       'groups':[],'excluded_directories':['round12-build','round12-gui-settings'],
       'scope':'utf8字段重新UTF8编码即原始字节；binary用base64；新代码目录不包含私人设置、密钥或模型。'}
for directory in sorted((root/'.local').glob('round12-*')):
    if not directory.is_dir() or directory.name in index['excluded_directories']:continue
    files=[]
    for path in sorted(directory.rglob('*')):
        if not path.is_file() or path.suffix in ['.exe','.zip']:continue
        raw=path.read_bytes()
        row={'path':path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
        try:row['utf8']=raw.decode('utf-8')
        except UnicodeDecodeError:row['base64']=base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii')
        files.append(row)
    encoded=(json.dumps({'files':files},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n').encode('utf-8')
    name=directory.name+'.json';(out/name).write_bytes(encoded)
    index['groups'].append({'file':name,'bytes':len(encoded),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest(),'entries':len(files)})
tools=[]
for path in sorted((root/'.local').glob('*.py')):
    if 'round12' in path.name:
        raw=path.read_bytes();tools.append({'path':path.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'utf8':raw.decode('utf-8')})
(out/'execution-tools.json').write_text(json.dumps({'files':tools},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
for name in ['round12-gui-launch.json']:
    path=root/'.local'/name
    if path.exists():(out/name).write_text(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'),encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
image=root/'.local/round12-gui/research-en.png'
if image.exists():(out/'research-query-debug.png').write_bytes(image.read_bytes())
index['changed_implementation_files']=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','3946d22295591aa080ff7bea007f9f410b245fc0','HEAD'],cwd=root).decode('utf-8').splitlines()
index['default_input_engine_and_shared_types_unchanged']=not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','3946d22295591aa080ff7bea007f9f410b245fc0','HEAD','--','crates/cloudleaf-input','crates/cloudleaf-types'],cwd=root)
(out/'index.json').write_text(json.dumps(index,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
count=0
for group in index['groups']:
    raw=(out/group['file']).read_bytes();assert len(raw)==group['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==group['sha256']
    for row in json.loads(raw)['files']:
        original=row['utf8'].encode('utf-8') if 'utf8' in row else base64.b64decode(row['base64'])
        assert len(original)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()==row['sha256'];count+=1
print(json.dumps({'groups':len(index['groups']),'raw_originals':count,'all_hashes_verified':True}))

"""为R12新提交保存一次精确push CI快照；旧记录不覆盖。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import subprocess
import urllib.request

credential_result = subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'credential.interactive=never', 'credential', 'fill'],
    input=b'protocol=https\nhost=github.com\n\n', stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=30)
if credential_result.returncode:
    raise RuntimeError('已有Git凭据不可用；未请求远程修改或保存凭据内容')
credential = dict(line.split('=', 1) for line in credential_result.stdout.decode('utf-8').splitlines() if '=' in line)
authorization = 'Bearer ' + credential['password']

label, commit, run_id = sys.argv[1:]
run_id = int(run_id)
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round12-ci' / label
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
API = 'https://api.github.com/repos/WanFengQC/Cloudleaf'
record = {'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'head_sha': commit, 'run_id': run_id,
          'authentication': 'Existing Git credential, process memory only; connector lists PR events only; exact push metadata uses official REST', 'tool_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'HTTP_responses': [], 'verified_pass': False}


def fetch(suffix, name):
    url = API + suffix
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'User-Agent': 'Cloudleaf-Round12-exact-push-CI', 'Authorization': authorization})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=45) as response:
        raw = response.read()
        record['HTTP_responses'].append({'url': url, 'status': response.status, 'file': name, 'bytes': len(raw),
                                         'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'headers': dict(response.headers)})
    (OUT / name).write_bytes(raw)
    return json.loads(raw)


try:
    runs = fetch(f'/actions/runs?head_sha={commit}&event=push&per_page=10', 'runs.json')
    run = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}', 'run.json')
    jobs = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs?per_page=100', 'jobs.json')['jobs']
    artifacts = fetch(f'/actions/runs/{run_id}/artifacts?per_page=100', 'artifacts.json')['artifacts']
    assert any(value['id'] == run_id and value['head_sha'] == commit and value['event'] == 'push' for value in runs['workflow_runs'])
    assert run['head_sha'] == commit and run['event'] == 'push'
    record.update({'url': run['html_url'], 'event': run['event'], 'status': run['status'], 'conclusion': run['conclusion']})
    record['jobs'] = [{'id': value['id'], 'name': value['name'], 'head_sha': value['head_sha'], 'status': value['status'],
                       'conclusion': value['conclusion'], 'steps': len(value['steps']),
                       'steps_ok': all(step['conclusion'] in ('success', 'skipped') for step in value['steps'])} for value in jobs]
    record['artifacts'] = [{'id': value['id'], 'name': value['name'], 'head_sha': value['workflow_run']['head_sha'],
                            'expired': value['expired'], 'digest': value.get('digest')} for value in artifacts]
    jobs_ok = len(jobs) == 2 and {value['name'] for value in jobs} == {'core (windows-latest)', 'core (ubuntu-latest)'}
    jobs_ok = jobs_ok and all(value['head_sha'] == commit and value['status'] == 'completed' and value['conclusion'] == 'success'
                              and all(step['conclusion'] in ('success', 'skipped') for step in value['steps']) for value in jobs)
    artifacts_ok = len(artifacts) == 3 and {value['name'] for value in artifacts} == {'core-performance-windows-latest', 'core-performance-ubuntu-latest', 'cloudleaf-translation-panel-windows-x86_64'}
    artifacts_ok = artifacts_ok and all(not value['expired'] and value['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == commit
                                        and value.get('digest', '').startswith('sha256:') for value in artifacts)
    record['verified_pass'] = run['status'] == 'completed' and run['conclusion'] == 'success' and jobs_ok and artifacts_ok
except Exception as error:
    record['error'] = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)}
    raise
finally:
    (OUT / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({name: value for name, value in record.items() if name != 'HTTP_responses'}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

"""记录密钥清理修复后的实际Cargo产物和物理工具链身份。"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
out=root/'.local/round12-artifacts-final'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
messages=[json.loads(line) for line in (root/'.local/round12-full-final/12-stdout.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
artifact=next(row for row in messages if row.get('reason')=='compiler-artifact' and row.get('executable') and row.get('target',{}).get('name')=='cloudleaf-translation-panel')
path=Path(artifact['executable'])
identity={'implementation_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root).decode().strip(),
          'executable':str(path),'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'cargo_artifact':artifact,'tools':{}}
for name in ['cargo','rustc','rustfmt','clippy-driver']:
    actual=Path(subprocess.check_output([str(Path.home()/'.cargo/bin/rustup.exe'),'which',name],cwd=root).decode().strip())
    identity['tools'][name]={'path':str(actual),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
identity['tools']['python']={'path':sys.executable,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(sys.executable).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'version':sys.version}
(out/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:identity[k] for k in ['implementation_commit','executable','bytes','sha256']}))

"""逐命令保存Round12精确实现的完整回归与隔离产物目录。"""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
out = root / '.local/round12-full'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
env['PYTHONIOENCODING'] = 'utf-8'
env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'] = str(root / '.local/round12-build')
cargo = shutil.which('cargo', path=env['PATH'])
commands = [
    ['git', 'diff', '--check'], [cargo, 'fmt', '--all', '--check'],
    [cargo, 'clippy', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline', '--', '-D', 'warnings'],
    [cargo, 'test', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline'],
    [cargo, 'test', '--workspace', '--doc', '--locked', '--offline'],
    [cargo, 'build', '--workspace', '--release', '--locked', '--offline'],
    [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/check_workspace.py'],
    [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v'],
    [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/audit_translation_dependencies.py', '--audit-binary',
     'C:/Users/EDY/WebstormProjects/Cloudleaf/.local/audit-tool/bin/cargo-audit.exe', '--output', str(out / 'dependency-audit.json')],
    [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/benchmark.py', '--iterations', '100', '--output', str(out / 'm2-performance.json')],
    [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/evaluate_algorithms.py', '--output-dir', str(out / 'algorithm-v1')],
    [cargo, 'build', '-p', 'cloudleaf-translation-panel', '--release', '--locked', '--offline', '--message-format=json'],
]
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root).decode().strip()
files = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], cwd=root).decode('utf-8').split('\0')
identity = {'head': head, 'at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'platform': platform.platform(),
    'python': sys.version, 'CARGO_TARGET_DIR': env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'], 'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'tracked_worktree_bytes': {name: hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in files if name}}
(out / 'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
rows=[]
for i, command in enumerate(commands, 1):
    start=time.perf_counter()
    result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True)
    row={'command':command,'returncode':result.returncode,'seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'head':head}
    for stream in ['stdout','stderr']:
        raw=getattr(result,stream);path=out/f'{i:02}-{stream}.txt';path.write_bytes(raw)
        row[stream]={'file':path.name,'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
    rows.append(row)
    (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'i':i,'returncode':result.returncode,'seconds':row['seconds']}),flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        print(result.stdout.decode('utf-8',errors='replace')[-2500:]+result.stderr.decode('utf-8',errors='replace')[-4500:],flush=True)
raise SystemExit(any(row['returncode'] for row in rows))
